title: Grocery Prices and Gold: Jeremiah Babe's Inflation Warning
description:
Original video author: jeremiah babe. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. jeremiah babe's grocery prices warning starts with a $320 weekly shop that included extra hurricane supplies. This recap follows his concerns about energy disruptions, an AI bubble and Treasury-market support, then his criticism of the optics of Trump's reported investments without alleging illegality. Next come his preference for gold, his plan to exchange it for property and his warning about a U.S. deficit approaching $2 trillion and middle-class strain.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
